test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**astonishing**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the unique and extraordinary abilities of arboreal apes, which are impressive to us. "Astonishing" is the most appropriate word here, as it conveys something that is surprisingly impressive or hard to believe.
 
• "**Astonishing**" fits well as it denotes something surprising and remarkable, aligning with the awe-inspired tone of the passage.
 
• "**Disappointing**" means something that fails to meet expectations, which contradicts the positive and impressive description of the apes' skills.
 
• "**Boring**" implies dullness or lack of interest, which is clearly the opposite of what is described in the passage, as the apes' abilities are seen as extraordinary.
 
• "**Frightening**" refers to something that causes fear, which is not relevant to the positive tone used in describing the apes' gymnastics and agility.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Man, it would seem, has (1)* descended__ *from arboreal apes. They lived a happy life in tropical forests, eating coconuts when they were hungry, and throwing them at each other when they were not. They were (2)* __perpetually__ *occupied in gymnastics and acquired an (3)* __agility__ *which to us is truly (4)* __astonishing__ *. But after some millions of years of this arboreal paradise, their numbers increased to the point where the supply of coconuts was no longer (5)* __sufficient__.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "Disappointing" implies something negative, which contradicts the tone of the passage that describes the apes' agility in a positive light.
 
• "Boring" does not fit the context of describing extraordinary skills and agility. It implies dullness, which is far from the intended meaning.
 
• "Frightening" is about fear, which does not align with the description of the impressive and skillful abilities of the apes.
